applicabilityBasis.summary: Ondo describes USDon as a dollar-backed stablecoin used for settlement of tokenized stocks. Public documentation supports payment/settlement design and 1:1 USDon/USDC swaps subject to swapper liquidity. It does not establish a contractual USDon issuer obligation to redeem for national currency or a national-currency bank deposit. The stock-redemption policy says wire-dollar redemptions are not supported, but it is not a complete USDon rights document. GENIUS section 2(22) excludes fixed-value digital assets from qualifying monetary-value redemption consideration. The reviewed public documents therefore leave the payment-stablecoin threshold unresolved. No security exclusion is inferred from the separately documented stock products.

genius.notes: Review as of 2026-10-07. The August 2026 issuer-prepared monthly report, verified by Ankura under the Sales Terms, names Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited as Issuer and includes USDon liabilities. Its collateral schedule is aggregate across products and does not establish a separately allocated USDon reserve schedule. The stock transparency page is not retained as a USDon-specific reserve-disclosure URL. Reserve-disclosure, redemption-policy and monthly-attestation booleans are omitted rather than extrapolated from stock redemption procedures or shared reporting. Enforcement status is omitted because the bounded name search does not establish an issuer-wide enforcement conclusion. No U.S. authorization, announced GENIUS pathway or registered foreign exception is asserted.
